with.install_args: node pnpm gitleaks shfmt aqua:rhysd/actionlint aqua:zizmorcore/zizmor aqua:google/osv-scanner

checks.name: Linear key check
checks.run:
node tools/scripts/linear.mjs check-pr
case "$PR_BRANCH" in renovate/*|changeset-release/*) exit 0 ;; esac
# The preset builds to dist for its tarball; here, before any build, Node reads its src (ADR 0025).
NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=@stackra/source pnpm exec commitlint --from "$BASE_SHA" --to "$HEAD_SHA"

checks.name: Lint
checks.run: pnpm exec turbo run lint --filter='!@figentra/mobile' --filter='!@figentra/playground' && pnpm lint:root

after.name: Committed manifests match gen
after.run:
if ! git diff --quiet -- '*stackra.manifest.json' '*src/node/entities.gen.ts'; then
  git diff --stat -- '*stackra.manifest.json' '*src/node/entities.gen.ts'
  echo "::error title=Stale manifests::run pnpm gen and commit the stackra.manifest.json and entities.gen.ts files above"
  exit 1
fi

after.name: Migration lint (Squawk)
after.run:
mapfile -t files < <(find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path '*/.stackra/migrations/*.up.sql' -print | sort)
if [ "${#files[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "::notice title=Squawk::no compiled migrations (.stackra/migrations) in this checkout; nothing linted"
  exit 0
fi
transactional=()
online=()
for file in "${files[@]}"; do
  if head -n 1 "$file" | grep -qx -- '-- stackra:transactional=false'; then online+=("$file"); else transactional+=("$file"); fi
done
lint() {
  mise exec github:sbdchd/squawk@2.71.0 -- squawk --pg-version=18.0 \
    --exclude=prefer-robust-stmts --exclude=prefer-text-field --exclude=ban-char-field \
    --exclude=prefer-bigint-over-int \
    --exclude=require-lock-timeout --exclude=require-statement-timeout "$@"
}
if [ "${#transactional[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then lint --assume-in-transaction "${transactional[@]}"; fi
if [ "${#online[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then lint "${online[@]}"; fi

after.name: Environment names (runway env check)
after.run:
pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@stackra/runway --output-logs=errors-only
pnpm runway env check

after.name: Check unused code
after.run:
pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@stackra/vitest-config --output-logs=errors-only
pnpm exec turbo run gen --filter='!@figentra/mobile' --filter='!@figentra/playground' --output-logs=errors-only
pnpm knip

steps.name: Uniwind Pro cache from figentra/ci-cache
steps.run:
version=$(awk '/^  uniwind-pro@[0-9]/ { sub(/^  uniwind-pro@/, ""); sub(/:$/, ""); print; exit }' \
  pnpm-lock.yaml)
dir="$UNIWIND_CACHE_DIR/$version"
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ -f "$dir/uniwind-pro-$version.tgz" ]; then exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$dir"
if ! gh release download "uniwind-pro-$version" --repo figentra/ci-cache \
  --pattern "uniwind-pro-$version.tgz*" --dir "$dir"; then
  echo "::notice title=Uniwind Pro::no uniwind-pro-$version release in figentra/ci-cache; downloading"
  exit 0
fi
published="https://cdn.uniwind.dev/uniwind-pro/checksums/$version"
expected=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 "$published" | awk '{ print tolower($1); exit }' || true)
actual=$(sha256sum "$dir/uniwind-pro-$version.tgz" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ print $1 }' || true)
if [ -n "$expected" ] && [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
  echo "Uniwind Pro $version seeded from figentra/ci-cache (sha256 $actual, as Uniwind publishes)"
else
  rm -rf "$dir"
  echo "::warning title=Uniwind Pro::seeded $version does not match the published sha256; dropped, downloading"
fi

steps.name: Uniwind Pro download cache (filled?)
steps.run:
if find "$UNIWIND_CACHE_DIR" -type f ! -name '*.sha256' -size +100k 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
  echo "filled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Lint, typecheck and build the mobile apps
steps.run: pnpm exec turbo run lint typecheck build --filter=@figentra/mobile --filter=@figentra/playground --continue=dependencies-successful

steps.name: No deploy target decided
steps.run: echo "No deploy target is decided yet (gap questionnaire DP1-DP7). Nothing is deployed."

agentsMd.facts:
pnpm 12 + Turborepo monorepo. Every rule lives in this repository (`.agents/rules/`, indexed below); there are no
global rules. Full guides: `apps/docs` (`pnpm docs`). Every member keeps its code in `src/`.

Where things live (path: what it holds, tier tag):

- `apps/console`: `@figentra/console` — Vite web app; authored `src/main.ts` until v3 generates the entry (ADR 0295) (`tier:app`)
- `apps/mobile`: `@figentra/mobile` — Expo app; authored `src/main.ts` until v3 generates the entry (ADR 0295) (`tier:app`)
- `apps/docs`: `@figentra/docs` — Fumadocs (ADR 0514); pages in `src/docs/` (ADRs in `src/docs/adr`), site config `src/config/docs.config.ts` (`tier:app`)
- `packages/<category>/<name>`: `@stackra/<name>`, flat inside one category: foundation, application, communication, connectors, cross-cutting, data, developer, experience, runtime, security, state (`tier:lib`)
- `packages/tooling/*`: `@stackra/{typescript,oxlint,vitest,tsdown,commitlint}-config`, exactly five presets (ADR 0300) (`tier:config`)
- `services/<name>`: `@figentra/service-<name>` — one member per service (`example`, `health`); root module `src/<key>.module.ts` (ADR 0294) (`tier:service`)
- `workers/<name>`: `@figentra/worker-<name>` — Cloudflare Worker members (`static`: `stackra-static`, static.stackra.figentra.com), `wrangler.jsonc`, ADR 0284 (`tier:app`)
- `tools/scripts`: repo helpers (Linear, bots, spec gates, runway); the checks and `pnpm new` are `stackra` commands, templates in `tools/scaffold`
- `.agents/hooks`, `.claude/settings.json`, `opencode.jsonc`: agent hooks and config
- `.notes`: private owner-only submodule (`git submodule update --init .notes`); CI and agents never need it; never reference its contents from public docs

Rules every member follows (`pnpm validate` enforces them):

- Versions come only from `pnpm-workspace.yaml` catalogs (`catalog:<name>`) or `workspace:*`. `catalogMode: strict`.
- `turbo.jsonc` extends `//` with exactly one tier tag, then its category and runtime tags; `tsconfig.json` extends one
  `@stackra/typescript-config` preset.
- `package.json` carries `keywords`, `repository` (with `directory`), `homepage`, `bugs`, `author`, `engines` and
  `"stackra": { "kind": "package", "tier", "category", "runtimes", "summary" }`, checked against
  `STACKRA_MANIFEST_SCHEMA` and the folder (ADR 0453 decision 11, amendment of 2026-10-27; `/standards/members`).
- Every test file sits directly in a `__tests__/` folder beside its subject (`src/**/__tests__/<name>.test.ts`), anywhere in the repo; no root `tests/`, no `.spec`. App e2e lives in the app. ADR 0022, enforced by `pnpm validate`.
- A package never imports an app, a service or `encore.dev`, nor another package's `src/`.
- A JSON config is `.jsonc` (comments welcome) when its tool reads JSONC; tsconfig files keep `.json` and take comments.
  The files that must stay strict `.json`, with the reason, are `MUST_STAY_JSON` in `@stackra/repo-checks`.

The programming model v3 is the target for new code (ADR 0294, 0295, 0296): a class declares its kind by its base
class, each file sits in its kind's one home group, identities are derived and locked in `stackra.manifest.json`, and
nobody writes `main.ts` or a tool config. No member is converted yet (STA-344) and its checks are planned (STA-338,
STA-339, STA-340), so today's code and `stackra validate --repository` still show the older shapes.

Reserve an ADR number before writing the ADR: `pnpm adr:reserve <slug> --issue STA-n` lands it in
`apps/docs/adr/numbers.yaml` on main first (STA-1732); never take "the highest on disk plus one" from a branch.

Done = `pnpm verify` green on the box after the merge (format, lint, typecheck, test, build, validate, boundaries, knip; "Tests run
later" below). Conventional commits.

Scope: every package is `@stackra/*` (free) or `@stackra-pro/*` (Pro, ADR 0461), never renamed and never another npm scope; publishing goes only to the Stackra registry (`https://npm.stackra.figentra.com/`, ADR 0453) from `.github/workflows/release.yml`, never npmjs or Keygen.

Deploys (owner decision 2026-10-28, ADR 0468): agents develop and deploy end to end. Dev and staging deploys and
prereleases run without the owner; production (a deploy, promote, rollback or package release) runs in CI and waits on
the owner's one GitHub Environment approval, which an agent may start. Secret values stay with the owner, main changes
only through a merged pull request, and a workstation `encore deploy` stays denied. Until the owner applies the guard
and settings edits listed on STA-1395, the guard still asks before staging deploys.

## Tests run later: merge now, label `needs-testing`

Owner decision 2026-11-03 (STA-2083, replaces "Tests run on the box"): nothing waits on tests before it lands. No box
run before the merge and no waiting on CI: open the pull request and merge it right away
(`figentra pr merge --admin [-R figentra/<repo>] <n>`, as stackra-bot; see below), then add the Linear label
`needs-testing` to its STA issue and a `Needs testing: <what to run>` line to the pull request body. The tester
lane later runs those tests on the box (`testbed run "core STA-n" . "pnpm verify"`) and removes the label.
GitHub CI runs no tests; its checks still run after the merge and stay visible. Nothing installs or tests on a
workstation.

## GitHub identity: agents are stackra-bot

Owner decision 2026-11-04 (STA-2105): agents act on GitHub only as the `stackra-bot` App. Raw `gh` and a plain
`git push` run as the owner's login `figentra-usr`, so they mean the owner; an agent never runs them, in any
repository or directory.

- In this repository: `pnpm bot:gh -- …`, `pnpm bot:git -- push origin HEAD`, `pnpm pr:merge <n>`.
- Anywhere else (another repository, `~/Projects/figentra`): `figentra bot gh …`,
  `figentra bot git push origin HEAD` and `figentra pr merge --admin [-R figentra/<repo>] <n>` from
  `@figentra/cli`. Each mints the installation token in-process from the sops `agents` scope (`secrets-exec.mjs`); none
  prints it or puts it on argv.
- A merge-now (`--admin`) merge lands only where the repository's rulesets name stackra-bot as a bypass actor. Where
  GitHub refuses it, hand the pull request to the leader for the owner; never retry as the owner.
- The bot has no `administration`, `environments`, `secrets` or `variables` permission. Rulesets, environments,
  branch protection, secrets, variables, App permissions and production approvals stay the owner's; a production
  dispatch by the bot stops at the owner check (`github.triggering_actor`).
agentsMd.land: Merge the pull request right away with `pnpm pr:merge <n>` under the owner's merge-now rule above (STA-2083): never wait on the gate. Then add the `needs-testing` label to its STA issue and a `Needs testing:` line to its body, and remove the worktree yourself.
